name: apiKey
label: API key
help: A Workspace API key (`nf_...`) from Narriflow under Settings, then Developer access. The Workspace needs an active Business plan.

name: baseUrl
label: Narriflow URL
help: Leave as `https://app.narriflow.com`. Change it only to connect a development or self-hosted deployment. Use the origin only, with no trailing slash and no `/api/v1`.
